modalLead: Widget titles are plain titles again, the // sits in one place on the whole page, and a title no longer jumps when you point at it.

items.text: Widget titles are plain titles again, over their card, not a header on top of it.
The // is in one place for categories and widgets alike, and a widget's name starts where the content of its card does.
A title stays put when you point at it, and is tinted where it stands.
